sentences.en: The river was turbid after the heavy rain.
sentences.zh: 大雨过后，河里的水很混浊。

sentences.en: She poured in some water to make the color of the paint more turbid.
sentences.zh: 她加了些水让颜料的颜色更浑浊一些。

sentences.en: The discussion became rather turbid when personal opinions entered the debate.
sentences.zh: 当个人意见掺杂进来时，这场讨论变得有些混乱。

senses.zh: cloudy or muddy 浑浊的，混乱的
